scope: Only final owned metadata/file-directory commit and CLI emission failure. Pure fixture metadata remains source/software/scientific false; no forged complete evidence, owner or SourceQ is supplied.

positive_rows.input: Fresh owned ordinary unqualified completion metadata, successful fsync/commit, emission and final original-clock check
positive_rows.expected: Exactly one complete structural completion survives; original deadline and all false qualification fields preserved.

negative_rows.fault: Original deadline expires immediately after real final copy or qualification-directory rename
negative_rows.expected: Nonzero/error; no accepted final target or qualifications directory. Preserve actual owned diagnostic and source bytes.

negative_rows.fault: CLI stdout emit raises BrokenPipeError/OSError after actual ordinary completion write/commit
negative_rows.expected: Nonzero/error; positive completion must be atomically invalidated or moved out of accepted location. An already-written complete:true file cannot survive as accepted evidence.

negative_rows.fault: CLI flush/fsync or final post-output original-clock check fails after successful native stage
negative_rows.expected: Completion false/absent, genuine native receipt preserved without relabelling actual child exit/closure, and no budget reset or numerical retry.

negative_rows.fault: Rollback/invalidation encounters a replaced/non-owned path or cannot complete
negative_rows.expected: Fail closed, preserve uncertainty/error and prohibit accepted publication; no borrowed deletion or invented cleanup/rollback success.

implementer_policy: One minimal completion/CLI finalization seam per existing producer may be exercised with real ordinary unqualified metadata and a failing emitter/clock. It cannot bypass source/evidence/native verification or accept trusted/fixture authority flags. Existing complete-source publication integration awaits genuine inputs.
